The '''Alzoc system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. Alzoc was part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] from circa [[30,000 BBY]] to [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
